{"path": "/results/10_feb_melting/gpt_oss/tool_calling/melting/task/level_2/brief/silicon_melting_2_trial_1/melt.in", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for melting silicon and diffusion calculation
units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Read initial crystal structure
read_data       Si.data

# Replicate 3x3x3
replicate       3 3 3

# Define Stillinger-Weber potential for Si
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Settings
neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    delay 5 every 1

# Define groups
group           all type 1

# ---------- Heating from 300K to 2500K ----------
# Use NPT ensemble with isotropic pressure control (0 atm)
variable        t_start equal 300.0
variable        t_end   equal 2500.0
variable        rate    equal 2.2   # K per ps
variable        dt      equal 0.002  # ps (2 fs)
# Number of steps for heating
variable        nstep_heating equal ceil((v_t_end - v_t_start)/(v_rate*v_dt))

fix             1 all npt temp ${t_start} ${t_end} ${rate} iso 0.0 0.0 1.0

# Output thermodynamic info every 1000 steps
thermo          1000
thermo_style    custom step temp press density

run             ${nstep_heating}

unfix           1

# ---------- Equilibration at 2500K for 500 ps ----------
variable        equil_time equal 500.0   # ps
variable        nstep_eq equal ${equil_time}/${dt}

fix             2 all npt temp ${t_end} ${t_end} 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             ${nstep_eq}
unfix           2

# ---------- Production for diffusion (MSD) ----------
# Compute MSD for all atoms
compute         myMSD all msd
# Average MSD over time
variable        msd equal c_myMSD[4]
# Output MSD every 1000 steps
fix             3 all ave/time 1 1000 1000 v_msd file msd.dat mode vector

# Run production for 200 ps
variable        prod_time equal 200.0   # ps
variable        nstep_prod equal ${prod_time}/${dt}
run             ${nstep_prod}

unfix           3

# End of script
"}
